items.q: But we were friends , we were with Sabby Lewis

ctx.x: Who gave that to you to read?

I think it was Idrees Sulieman. His name was Graham before that. But we were friends , we were with Sabby Lewis, you know, and when he became involved with that I listened, because, you know, I listen to everybody. And I saw the good points, but I says, "I been thinkin', you have to change your children's names and your social security card and everything's got to be changed and you gotta get your name changed legally and your children become somethin' else, different names, and they got to live through all…
friends, you know, we're still friends. Yeah. But they approached me with that, yeah. And Sadik, you know, the piano player.
